rows.QUE_TEXT: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_SCHEDEND < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_PRIORITY = '1' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_PRIORITY = '2' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE (EVT_STATUS = 'R' OR (EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_SCHEDEND < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD'))) AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'Q' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_STATUS = 'R' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_STATUS = 'IP' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND UOG_ORG=EVT_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5REQUISITIONS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE REQ_STATUS = 'R' AND REQ_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ORDERS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ORD_RSTATUS = 'A' AND ORD_STATUS NOT IN ('AR', 'PR') AND ORD_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ORDERS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ORD_STATUS = 'PR' AND ORD_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ORDERS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ORD_RSTATUS = 'A' AND ORD_STATUS <> 'AR' AND ORD_DUE < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND ORD_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5WARCOVERAGES WHERE WCV_OBJECT = EVT_OBJECT AND WCV_OBJECT_ORG = EVT_OBJECT_ORG AND WCV_ACTIVE = '+' AND WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') ) AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5WARCOVERAGES WHERE WCV_OBJECT = EVT_OBJECT AND WCV_OBJECT_ORG = EVT_OBJECT_ORG AND WCV_ACTIVE = '+' AND WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + 60, 'DD')) AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5WARCLAIMS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE WCL_RSTATUS <> 'C' AND WCL_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5DOCUMENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5WARCOVERAGES WHERE WCV_WARRANTY = DOC_CODE AND WCV_ACTIVE = '+' AND WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + 60, 'DD')) AND DOC_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE BOO_OCRTYPE WHEN 'N' THEN BOO_HOURS WHEN 'O' THEN BOO_HOURS ELSE 0 END) / SUM(BOO_HOURS), 2) FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS WHERE BOO_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND BOO_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND (BOO_EVENT IS NULL OR BOO_EVENT IN (SELECT EVT_CODE FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE))

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE EVT_JOBTYPE WHEN 'PM' THEN BOO_HOURS WHEN 'FPM' THEN BOO_HOURS ELSE 0 END) / SUM(BOO_HOURS), 2) FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND BOO_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND BOO_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE EVT_PRIORITY WHEN '1' THEN BOO_HOURS ELSE 0 END) / SUM(BOO_HOURS), 2) FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND BOO_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND BOO_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND (100 * SUM(CASE WHEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(EVT_COMPLETED, 'DD') <= EVT_SCHEDEND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(1), 2) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_JOBTYPE = 'PM' AND EVT_SCHEDEND > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND EVT_SCHEDEND < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE EVT_JOBTYPE WHEN 'PM' THEN BOO_HOURS ELSE 0 END) / SUM(BOO_HOURS), 2) FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND BOO_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND BOO_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE BOO_OCRTYPE WHEN 'O' THEN BOO_HOURS ELSE 0 END) / SUM(BOO_HOURS), 2) FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND BOO_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND BOO_EVENT=EVT_CODE AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT  ROUND(100 * (CASE WHEN B.Y in (0, null) THEN 0 ELSE (A.X / B.Y) END), 2) FROM  (SELECT SUM(ACT_EST) X FROM R5EVENTS, R5ACTIVITIES, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ACT_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND EVT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANC', 'REJ') AND EVT_JOBTYPE = 'PM' AND EVT_COMPLETED > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND EVT_COMPLETED <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) A, (SELECT SUM(BOO_HOURS) Y FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND EVT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANC', 'REJ') AND EVT_JOBTYPE = 'PM' AND EVT_COMPLETED > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND EVT_COMPLETED <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) B

SELECT  ROUND(100 * A.X / B.Y, 2) FROM  (SELECT SUM(ACS_HOURS) X FROM R5ACTSCHEDULES, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ACS_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND EVT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANC', 'REJ') AND EVT_RTYPE IN ('JOB', 'PPM') AND EVT_COMPLETED > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND EVT_COMPLETED <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) A, (SELECT SUM(BOO_HOURS) Y FROM R5BOOKEDHOURS, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE BOO_EVENT = EVT_CODE AND EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND EVT_STATUS NOT IN ('CANC', 'REJ') AND EVT_RTYPE IN ('JOB', 'PPM') AND EVT_COMPLETED > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND EVT_COMPLETED <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) B

SELECT  ROUND(100 * A.X / B.Y, 2) FROM  (SELECT COUNT(*) X FROM R5PROPERTYVALUES, R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND EVT_STATUS = 'H' AND EVT_CODE = PRV_CODE AND 'EVNT' = PRV_RENTITY AND PRV_PROPERTY = 'HOLD' AND  PRV_SEQNO = 1 AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) A, (SELECT SUM(1) Y FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC' AND EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) B

SELECT  ROUND(100 * A.X / B.Y, 2) FROM  (SELECT COUNT(*) X FROM R5PROPERTYVALUES, R5ORDERS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ORD_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND ORD_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND ORD_CODE+'#'+ORD_ORG = PRV_CODE AND 'PORD' = PRV_RENTITY AND PRV_PROPERTY = 'PRIORITY' AND PRV_SEQNO = 1 AND ORD_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) A, (SELECT SUM(1) Y FROM R5ORDERS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE ORD_DATE > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND ORD_DATE <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND ORD_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) B

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(WCL_CLOSEAMOUNT,0) + COALESCE(WCL_OTHERCLOSE,0)) FROM R5WARCLAIMS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE WCL_RSTATUS = 'C' AND WCL_RESOLVED >= dbo.TO_DATE('01/01/'+SUBSTRING(dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'),7,4), 'DD/MM/YYYY')  AND WCL_RESOLVED <= GetDate() AND WCL_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(EVT_DOWNTIMEHRS, 0)) FROM R5EVENTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(EVT_COMPLETED, 'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() - 30, 'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(EVT_COMPLETED, 'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), 'DD') AND EVT_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE

SELECT ROUND(100 * A.X / B.Y, 2) FROM  (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(STO_BASEPRICE , 0 ) * COALESCE(BIS_QTY, 0))  X FROM R5BINSTOCK, R5STOCK, R5STORES, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE STO_STORE = BIS_STORE AND STO_PART = BIS_PART AND STO_PART_ORG = BIS_PART_ORG AND STO_STORE = STR_CODE AND STR_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) A, (SELECT SUM(OBJ_VALUE) Y FROM R5OBJECTS, R5USERORGANIZATION WHERE OBJ_ORG=UOG_ORG AND UOG_USER=:MP5USER AND UOG_ROLE = :MP5ROLE) B

SELECT count(*) FROM r5objlinearref
WHERE lrf_objorg='orgn' AND
(lrf_objcode='equip' or lrf_re_objcode='equip')

select c.cev_event, nvl (d.des_text, e.evt_desc)
from r5descriptions d, r5events e, r5calcevents c
where d.des_lang (+) = 'planguage'
and d.des_code (+) = e.evt_code
and d.des_rentity (+) = 'EVNT'
and e.evt_code = c.cev_event 
and c.cev_rstatus in ('A','U')
ORDER BY c.cev_event desc

select e.eiv_code, d.des_text
from r5descriptions d, r5extinvoices e
where d.des_lang (+) = 'planguage'
and d.des_code (+) = e.eiv_debtor
and d.des_rentity (+) = 'DEB'
and e.eiv_rstatus = 'C'
ORDER BY e.eiv_code desc

select e.eiv_code, d.des_text
from r5descriptions d, r5extinvoices e
where d.des_lang (+) = 'planguage'
and d.des_code (+) = e.eiv_debtor
and d.des_rentity (+) = 'DEB'
ORDER BY e.eiv_code desc

select e.evt_code, nvl (d.des_text, e.evt_desc)
from r5descriptions d, r5events e
where d.des_lang (+) = 'planguage'
and d.des_code (+) = e.evt_code
and d.des_rentity (+) = 'EVNT'
and not exists (
      select null from r5calcevents c
      where c.cev_rstatus in ('A','I','E')
      and c.cev_incrementable is null
      and c.cev_event = e.evt_code)
and e.evt_rtype in ('JOB','PPM')
ORDER BY e.evt_code desc

select c.cev_event, nvl (d.des_text, e.evt_desc)
from r5descriptions d, r5events e, r5calcevents c
where d.des_lang (+) = 'planguage'
and d.des_code (+) = e.evt_code
and d.des_rentity (+) = 'EVNT'
and e.evt_code = c.cev_event and c.cev_rstatus ='I'

SELECT YEAR( cwr_date ), 
       MONTH( cwr_date ), 
       dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( N'planguage', N'MRC', cwr_mrc, NULL, NULL ),
       cwr_wosreported
FROM   r5scworkordersreported
WHERE  cwr_org = N'userorg'
ORDER BY dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( N'planguage', N'MRC', cwr_mrc, NULL, NULL )

SELECT YEAR( cws_date ), 
       MONTH( cws_date ), 
       dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( N'planguage', N'UCOD', cws_jobtype, N'JBTP', NULL ), 
       COALESCE(cws_costdefcurr, 0)
FROM   r5scworkordercost
WHERE  cws_org = N'userorg'

SELECT R.RYear LaborYear, R.RMonth LaborMonth, R.WOTypeDesc, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(R.BookedHours,0)),0) BookedHours, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(R.EstimatedHours,0)),0) EstimatedHours FROM ( SELECT YEAR(boo_date) RYear, MONTH(boo_date) RMonth, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc('EN', 'UCOD', evt_jobtype, 'JBTP', null) WOTypeDesc, COALESCE(boo_hours,0) BookedHours, 0 EstimatedHours 
FROM r5events, r5bookedhours 
WHERE evt_code = boo_event AND
evt_rtype in ('JOB','PPM') AND 
evt_parent IS NULL AND 
evt_rstatus = 'C' AND 
boo_date IS NOT NULL AND 
evt_org = 'userorg' AND 
( YEAR(boo_date) = YEAR(GETDATE()) OR YEAR(boo_date) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1) UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(act_start) RYear, MONTH(act_start) RMonth, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc('EN', 'UCOD', evt_jobtype, 'JBTP', null) WOTypeDesc, 0 BookedHours, COALESCE(act_est,0) EstimatedHours FROM r5events, r5activities WHERE evt_code = act_event AND evt_rtype in ('JOB','PPM') AND evt_parent IS NULL AND evt_rstatus = 'C' AND act_start IS NOT NULL AND evt_org = 'userorg' AND ( YEAR(act_start) = YEAR(GETDATE()) OR YEAR(act_start) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1) ) R 
GROUP BY R.RYear, R.RMonth, R.WOTypeDesc

SELECT R.RYear LaborYear, R.RMonth LaborMonth, R.WOTypeDesc, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(R.BookedHours,0)),0) BookedHours, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(R.ScheduledHours,0)),0) ScheduledHours FROM ( SELECT YEAR(boo_date) RYear, MONTH(boo_date) RMonth, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc('EN', 'UCOD', evt_jobtype, 'JBTP', null) WOTypeDesc, COALESCE(boo_hours,0) BookedHours, 0 ScheduledHours 
FROM r5events, r5bookedhours 
WHERE evt_code = boo_event AND 
evt_rtype in ('JOB','PPM') AND 
evt_parent IS NULL AND 
evt_rstatus = 'C' AND 
boo_date IS NOT NULL AND 
evt_org = 'userorg' AND 
( YEAR(boo_date) = YEAR(GETDATE()) OR YEAR(boo_date) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1) UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(acs_sched) RYear, MONTH(acs_sched) RMonth, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc('EN', 'UCOD', evt_jobtype, 'JBTP', null) WOTypeDesc, 0 BookedHours, COALESCE(acs_hours,0) ScheduledHours FROM r5events, r5actschedules WHERE evt_code = acs_event AND evt_rtype in ('JOB','PPM') AND evt_parent IS NULL AND evt_rstatus = 'C' AND acs_sched IS NOT NULL AND  evt_org = 'userorg' AND ( YEAR(acs_sched) = YEAR(GETDATE()) OR YEAR(acs_sched) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1) ) R 
GROUP BY R.RYear, R.RMonth, R.WOTypeDesc

select cls_code des_code,
       cls_org des_org,
       isnull(des_text, cls_desc) des_text
from   r5classes LEFT OUTER JOIN r5descriptions on (  des_code  = cls_code
										and    des_org  = cls_org
										and    des_rentity = 'CLAS'
										and    des_rtype  = N'pfunrentity'
										and    des_lang  = N'planguage' )
where  cls_rentity = N'pfunrentity'
and    isnull(cls_notused, '-') = '-'
order by cls_code

select cls_code des_code,
       cls_org des_org
from r5userorganization, r5classes
where cls_rentity = 'pfunrentity'  
and cls_org = uog_org 
and uog_user = 'puser' 
and ( uog_org = 'porg'
      OR uog_org ='*' 
      OR ( uog_common = '+' 
           and  cls_code <> '*'  ) ) 
and uog_role = 'prole' 
and COALESCE(cls_notused, '-') <> '+'
and cls_code = 'pwoclass'

select  uco_code,  isnull(des_text, uco_desc) uco_desc    
from   r5descriptions RIGHT OUTER JOIN 
       r5ucodes ON ( des_code  = uco_code
			and    des_rtype  = uco_rentity
			and    des_lang  = N'planguage'
			and    des_rentity  = 'UCOD' )
where  uco_rentity  = N'ptypeentity'
pextrawhere
and    uco_code <> '*'
ORDER BY uco_desc

select d.des_code,
       d.des_text
from   r5descriptions d
where  d.des_rtype = 'JBPR'
and    d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and    d.des_lang = 'planguage'
order by d.des_text

select d.des_code, d.des_text from r5descriptions d RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes u on ( d.des_rtype = uco_rentity and d.des_code=u.uco_code and d.des_lang = 'planguage' ) where d.des_rentity = 'UCOD' and u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  pexclause and ( exists ( select 'x' from r5jobtypeauth j where j.jta_jobtype = d.des_code permclause and ( j.jta_group = 'porggroup' or j.jta_group= '*' )) or  exists ( select 'x' from r5install i where i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH' and upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) ) ) 
and ( 'pskiptypefilter' = 'true' 
       or    exists( select 'x'
              from r5fieldfiltertype
              where fft_function = 'pfunction' 
              and d.des_code = fft_type ) 
      or
      not exists(select 'x'
              from r5fieldfiltertype
              where fft_function = 'pfunction' 
              ) )
order by d.des_text

select a.aut_statnew,
       d.des_text
from   r5auth a,
       r5descriptions d,
       r5entities e
where  ( a.aut_user = N'puser'
         or a.aut_group = N'pgroup'
        and a.aut_user = '*' )
and    ( a.aut_status = '*' or
         a.aut_status = N'poldstat' )
and     a.aut_rentity = N'pfunrrentity'
and     a.aut_type = '+'
and     a.aut_statnew <> N'poldstat'
and     not exists ( select *
                     from   r5auth x
                     where  x.aut_group = N'pgroup'
                     and    x.aut_user = N'puser'
                     and    ( x.aut_status = '*'

         OR ('pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( rqm_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+' 
         AND (COALESCE( rqm_gen, '-' ) = '+' 
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r5reqclasses
                   WHERE rcl_reqm = rqm_code
                   AND rcl_class = 'pequipmeclass'
                   AND rcl_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg'))))
       UNION
       SELECT cau_code rqm_code, 'CAUS' rqm_type, cau_group rqm_group
       FROM r5causes
       WHERE COALESCE( cau_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       AND cau_group IS NOT NULL
       AND (('ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( cau_partfailure, '-' ) = '+')
         OR ('pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( cau_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+' 
         AND (COALESCE( cau_gen, '-' ) = '+' 
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r5causeclasses
                   WHERE cac_cause = cau_code
                   AND cac_class = 'pequipmeclass'
                   AND cac_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg'))))
       UNION
       SELECT fal_code rqm_code, 'FAIL' rqm_type, fal_group rqm_group
       FROM r5failures
       WHERE COALESCE( fal_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       AND fal_group IS NOT NULL
       AND (('ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( fal_partfailure, '-' ) = '+')
         OR ('pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( fal_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+' 
         AND (COALESCE( fal_gen, '-' ) = '+' 
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r5failureclasses
                   WHERE fca_failure = fal_code
                   AND fca_class = 'pequipmeclass'
                   AND fca_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg'))))
       UNION
       SELECT acc_code rqm_code, 'ACCO' rqm_type, acc_group rqm_group
       FROM r5actioncodes
       WHERE COALESCE( acc_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       AND acc_group IS NOT NULL
       AND (('ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( acc_partfailure, '-' ) = '+')
         OR ('pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( acc_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+' 
         AND (COALESCE( acc_gen, '-' ) = '+' 
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r5actclasses
                   WHERE acl_action = acc_code
                   AND acl_class = 'pequipmeclass'
                   AND acl_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg')))) ) r

WITH t( cch_parentclosingcode, cch_childclosingcode, cch_parentclosingcodetype, cch_childclosingcodetype, cch_object, cch_object_org ) AS (
        SELECT cch_parentclosingcode, cch_childclosingcode, cch_parentclosingcodetype, cch_childclosingcodetype, cch_object, cch_object_org
        FROM   r5closingcodehierarchy
        WHERE  cch_parentclosingcode     = 'pparentclosingcode'
        AND    cch_parentclosingcodetype = 'pparenttype'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.cch_parentclosingcode, c.cch_childclosingcode, c.cch_parentclosingcodetype, c.cch_childclosingcodetype, c.cch_object, c.cch_object_org
        FROM   r5closingcodehierarchy c 
               JOIN t ON t.cch_childclosingcode = c.cch_parentclosingcode AND t.cch_childclosingcodetype = c.cch_parentclosingcodetype ) 
SELECT DISTINCT cch_parentclosingcode + '#' + cch_parentclosingcodetype parentclosingcode, 
        cch_childclosingcode + '#' + cch_childclosingcodetype childclosingcode 
FROM   t
WHERE  ( ( COALESCE( 'pequipment', '#' ) = '#' AND cch_object IS NULL AND cch_object_org IS NULL ) 
         OR 
         ( ( cch_object = 'pequipment' AND cch_object_org = 'pequiporg' ) 
           OR 
           ( cch_object IS NULL  AND cch_object_org IS NULL ) ) ) 
AND    cch_childclosingcode + '#' + cch_childclosingcodetype IN 
( SELECT rqm_code + '#RECO'
  FROM   r5requircodes 
  WHERE  COALESCE( rqm_notused, '-' ) <> '+' 
  AND    ( ( 'ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( rqm_partfailure, '-' ) = '+' ) 
           OR 
           ( 'pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( rqm_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+'  
             AND ( COALESCE( rqm_gen, '-' ) = '+' OR 
                   EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5reqclasses WHERE rcl_reqm = rqm_code AND rcl_class = 'pequipmeclass' AND rcl_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg' ) ) ) ) 
  UNION 
  SELECT cau_code + '#CAUS'
  FROM   r5causes 
  WHERE  COALESCE( cau_notused, '-' ) <> '+' 
  AND    ( ( 'ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( cau_partfailure, '-' ) = '+' ) 
           OR 
           ( 'pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( cau_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+'  
             AND ( COALESCE( cau_gen, '-' ) = '+' OR 
                   EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5causeclasses WHERE cac_cause = cau_code AND cac_class = 'pequipmeclass' AND cac_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg') ) ) ) 
  UNION 
  SELECT fal_code + '#FAIL'
  FROM   r5failures 
  WHERE  COALESCE( fal_notused, '-' ) <> '+' 
  AND    ( ( 'ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( fal_partfailure, '-' ) = '+' ) 
           OR 
           ( 'pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( fal_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+'  
             AND ( COALESCE( fal_gen, '-' ) = '+' OR 
                   EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5failureclasses WHERE fca_failure = fal_code AND fca_class = 'pequipmeclass' AND fca_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg' ) ) ) ) 
  UNION 
  SELECT acc_code + '#ACCO' 
  FROM   r5actioncodes 
  WHERE  COALESCE( acc_notused, '-' ) <> '+' 
  AND    ( ( 'ppartfailureparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( acc_partfailure, '-') = '+' ) 
           OR 
           ( 'pworkorderparam' = 'true' AND COALESCE( acc_enableworkorders, '-' ) = '+'  
             AND ( COALESCE(acc_gen, '-') = '+' OR 
                   EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5actclasses WHERE acl_action = acc_code AND acl_class = 'pequipmeclass' AND acl_class_org = 'pequipmenclassorg' ) ) ) ) )

         ELSE
           CAST(a.act_act AS NVARCHAR) + (CASE WHEN  a.act_trade IS NOT NULL THEN ' - ' +

    LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      r5userresponsibilities ON urs_user = 'puser' and urs_responsibility in (tsk_viewonlyresp, tsk_reviewresp, tsk_performbyresp, tsk_performby2resp)
    WHERE 
    tsk_code = a.act_task
    AND tsk_revision = a.act_taskrev
    AND ((
      tsk_viewonlyresp IS NULL
      AND tsk_reviewresp IS NULL
      AND tsk_performbyresp IS NULL
      AND tsk_performby2resp IS NULL
    ) OR (
      urs_responsibility = tsk_viewonlyresp
      OR urs_responsibility = tsk_reviewresp

      OR urs_responsibility = tsk_performby2resp
